strategy.primary: cEDH spell-copy: land Azula fast, attack, and cast rituals, untaps, draw and combo pieces while she's attacking so each resolves twice; win with Azula + Narset's Reversal/Underworld Breach + Frantic Search, Breach + LED/Petal + Brain Freeze, or Thassa's Oracle.
strategy.secondary: Generic Grixis cEDH shell (fast mana, free counters, tutors, Necropotence/Ad Nauseam) wins without Azula when she can't attack.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Fire Lord Azula
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Firebending 2 (Whenever this creature attacks, add {R}{R}. This mana lasts until end of combat.)
Whenever you cast a spell while Fire Lord Azula is attacking, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)

identity.why: Copies each spell cast while she attacks.
With Frantic Search under Azula, an infinite loop.
Free untap-draw spell that loops under Azula.
Flash so sorceries can be copied in combat.
One discard, double Treasure and cards.
